observations: L02, L03, L04, L09, L12, L14, L15, L16, L20, L21: long joins (الظـلّ, بأَقـلّ, فيُقـال, ومبلـغ, نقطـة, مـا, عنـد, فـاذا, هـذا, فهـو, نقطـة, فهـو, فقوّسـه) are not transcribed.

L03: يُجْزَأَ: a damma over the yā', a sukun over the jīm, a fatha over the zāy and a hamza with a fatha over the alif (1600 dpi). بأَقلّ: a hamza with a fatha over the alif and a shadda over the lām.
L04: وبأَكثر: the hamza and the fatha in one mark (3.6 x 4.7 pt). يُريد has a damma and no kasra; انما has no shadda (the mark beside it is the shadda of الظلّ).
L05, L06, L17: جُعل has a damma over the jīm and no kasra under the ʿayn; وزدْ (L06) has a sukun and no kasra, وزد (L17) neither.

L06, L18, L21, L23: broken letters: in على (L06) the foot of the lām did not print and its stem stands free over the bowl of the yā' (as on p. 28); the lām of مثلها (L18) stands free (a stroke 1.4 x 6.5 pt, read as an alif by Tesseract); the alif of وان (L21) printed short (5.8 pt), and that of فاطلُب (L23) short with its foot as a separate fragment.

L08, L10, L11, L18, L19, L21: مُثلَّثة (L08) has a damma over the mīm and a shadda with a fatha over the lām, no vowel on the first thā'; مثلَّثة (L18, L19, L21) has the shadda and the fatha (one mark 3.6 x 4.7 pt on L21), مثلّثة (L10, L11) the shadda alone.
L08: فاحفَظْه: a fatha over the second fā' and a sukun over the ẓā'. جِذْره (also L18): a kasra under the jīm and a sukun over the dhāl.
L22, L23: اردت and واردت have no shadda (اردتّ on L05, L15, L17 and L24 has one).
L23: فاطلُب: the damma over the lām printed without its tail: an oval head (2.2 x 2.5 pt) with the notch of a damma's head, unlike the round sukun of this type (4000 dpi).
L24: تِلْقاءَه: a kasra under the tā', a sukun over the lām, and the hamza with a fatha over it (2.9 x 4.7 pt in all, as تلقاءَه on pp. 9-13).
